page.layout: One centred column of title lines, with a red wax seal and engraving on the right-centre, and the imprint line at the foot.

main_text.l: ROMAE. Typis S. Cong. Propag. Fidei, Anno. 1662.

page.notes: Central engraving in a circular border: a group of figures (apostles or saints) in a landscape, with a legend around the rim in capitals, partly legible as "...EUNTES·IN·UNIVERSUM·MUNDUM·PRÆDICATE·EVANGELIUM·OMNI·CREAT..." and the rest of the rim too worn to read. Not transcribed as text. A red wax seal lies at the right of the engraving, its device not legible. The year at the foot is printed "166" followed by a worn final figure, read as 1662.
